I’ll slam the laptop shut or change the channel immediately. Even driving past the big hospital near my apartment makes me nauseous and shaky because I start imagining brain scans and bad news.

I don’t really do any checking rituals or tests over and over. I avoid them instead. I keep putting off seeing a neurologist because I’m so scared they’ll confirm it. The fear feels instant and overwhelming, tied to that one specific illness.
